Lina (AE): Quick sync 50k ARR prospect wants SIG/CAIQ answers + our incident response timeline for contract. They also asked if we can commit to <=48h notification. Need a short FAQ for procurement by 11am PT tomorrow.

Omar (Security): I can pull the SIG/CAIQ. Our standard customer notification is within 72 hours of confirmed data impact. Operationally we ack in 1 hour, scope within 24, contain asap. We can discuss 48h as a contracted SLA for enterprise depending on indemnity and cooperation clauses.

Ben (Solutions): For the POC they want VPC with customer-managed KMS. We don't hold keys by default. If they want temporary key escrow for the trial, that's a paid add-on and requires Legal + Security sign-off.

Lina (AE): They specifically asked: "If Redwood detects a breach affecting our data, when will we be notified?" Put that exact wording in the packet.

Omar (Security): Draft language: "Initial acknowledgement within 1 hour of detection; triage & scope within 24 hours; containment activities ongoing with goal within 24 hours; customer notification within 72 hours of confirmed impact. Regulatory notifications as required by law." I'll add contact points: security@redwood.ai, ir-oncall@redwood.ai.

Hannah (Legal): For contract clause options: (1) Standard: 72h notification; (2) Enterprise SLA: 48h notification subject to higher liability cap and active cooperation in forensic investigations. Also we'll add a deletion certificate requirement if keys are escrowed.

Ben (Solutions): POC pricing suggestion: 4-week VPC POC, 3 GPU nodes, 35% off reserved rate, includes two enablement hours. Escrow add-on: one-time fee + PS hours to manage key lifecycle.

Lina (AE): Nice. Omar can you include SOC2 redacted link and last pentest date in the SIG answers? They asked for evidence.

Omar (Security): SOC2 redacted: https://files.redwood/security/soc2-redacted-2026.pdf. Latest pentest: 2026-03-15. I'm uploading SIG/IR answers to sales/poc now.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Upload complete: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/prospect-sig-caiq-1782809999.zip

Hannah (Legal): I'll prepare two short clauses and a sample notification flow. Note: customers insisting on 48h without indemnity are a legal risk; we'll flag that.

Lina (AE): Great team. Target: assemble packet (SIG answers + SOC2 link + IR timeline + SOW/pricing + contract clause options) and send by 10:30 PT tomorrow. Omar/Hannah/Bob? (typo) Ben please confirm pricing in the SOW.

Ben (Solutions): Confirmed. I'll drop SOW to sales/poc tonight.

Omar (Security): Added a brief IR playbook excerpt and contact matrix in the upload. Also clarified controls that are Private-only.

Lina (AE): Thanks everyone 20: looping back once bundle is ready.

Hannah (Legal): Will include sample language for key escrow deletion certificate and forensics cooperation.

Ben (Solutions): FYI if they need live demo access we require demo dataset only; no production data in POC.

Lina (AE): Closing loop. We'll offer standard 72h + optional 48h with conditions. Sending tomorrow AM. Thanks :thumbsup:
